title: 공군교육사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 1 (Establishment and Duties)
(1) The Air Force Education and Training Command (hereinafter referred to as the "Command") shall be established within the Air Force.
(2) The Command shall be responsible for matters concerning flight training, specialized military education, and military education and training for persons who will become commissioned officers, noncommissioned officers, or enlisted personnel (excluding cadets), reserve commissioned officers, noncommissioned officers, or enlisted personnel, and candidates for military officers, as well as educational development in the Air Force. <Amended on September 22, 2017>
